definition.scenario: A named variation of inputs used to model a specific financial event without altering core system logic.

rules.rule: A scenario may only modify input values, not contract logic.
Scenarios must reference the same input schema as baseline runs.
A scenario may introduce one_time_events but may not reclassify mandatory obligations.
Scenario-specific notes are allowed but must not affect calculations.
Multiple scenarios may be compared, but no scenario may mutate another scenario’s data.

notes: Scenarios are descriptive variations for learning and clarity. They do not alter system rules or suggest actions.
